name: 74063 · Sand Springs, OK
findings: ZIP 74063 (Sand Springs) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74063 (Sand Springs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 74063 (Sand Springs) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
